description: This file defines extension methods for configuring various services and middleware in an ASP.NET Core application, including Dependency Injection setup, JWT authentication configuration, and logging setup with Serilog.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: Provides static extension methods for configuring application services including Dependency Injection, JWT authentication, and logging.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Sets up MediatR, validation, AutoMapper, and registers various services related to user profiles, passwords, JWT tokens, and current user accessor.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Configures JWT bearer authentication including token validation parameters and message handling.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Configures Serilog logger with console sink and attaches it to the ILoggerFactory.
